basis: The DAG scheduler already launches ready tasks in remaining-path order, but only when every task has a duration estimate; adaptive plans set every duration to unknown, so ties fell back to catalog order. In D078 the producer n5 that the generator leaf n2 waited for started at 465 s while independent leaves n1, n3, n4 took both slots first.

estimate.source_ref: D078 leaf workload: requirement counts 3-18, worker wall 19-716 s; the count ranks a leaf with a waiting consumer ahead of single leaves, not a duration prediction

applied: Before the plan is committed: implementation tasks get max(minimum_ms, per_requirement_ms x requirement count); the verification task gets verification_ms. The scheduler then orders ready tasks by remaining path.
